Arsenal Manager Mikel Arteta Reacts to Brighton Loss

Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta acknowledged troubles within his team following a defeat to Brighton. He admitted to sensing issues during the match and explained his decisions regarding substitutions. Reports indicate Arteta was "furious" after the loss, with former player Jamie Carragher suggesting one specific aspect would deeply hurt him. The defeat saw Arsenal "thumped" by Brighton.
